note: Provisional tool allowlist pending Aidan's simulator catalogue (BL-008). Policy rules are the fictional organisation's own rules from the scenario draft.

policy_rules.statement: Evidence must be preserved before a device is re-imaged; Preservation precedes Eradication.
Disabling a staff account requires IT manager approval.
Customer personal data accessed by an unauthorised party must be reported to the DPO.
A SOC analyst may approve isolating a user laptop alone.

assessment: Identify which accounts, passwords and sessions were exposed.
preservation: Preserve memory and disk images before re-imaging.
Export relevant auth, endpoint and CRM logs with hashes.
containment: Isolate the affected endpoint when suspicious activity is evidence-backed.
Revoke stolen sessions and reset saved passwords.
Block malicious domains and IP addresses.
eradication: Remove malicious files and persistence mechanisms.
Re-image the compromised device only after preservation.
hardening: Address the weakness that enabled the incident (unmanaged software installs).
Add detection for the observed technique.
restoration: Restore normal operations and verify security.
Confirm the stolen session can no longer be used.
